notes.title: Service Termination of Random Tower Defense
notes.content:
Hello,
We are Random Tower Defense(RTD) dev team.

We sincerely thank you for your love and support to Random Tower Defense.

After a long long consideration, we decided to end the service of Random Tower Defense. We have continued servicing since 2020, but we had a difficulty to maintain its service and concluded that we need to discontinue it. We appreciate you for playing Random Tower Defense.

Random Tower Defense’s server will be maintained by Feb. 29th, 2024 (KST).
Any issues regarding refund will be regulated under Steam’s policy.

Please refer to the details about service termination below.

Game’s Service Termination Date: 
    - KST (UTC +9)12:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - PST (UTC -8): 19:00, Feb. 28th, 2024
    - NZDT (UTC +13): 16:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - AEDT (UTC +11): 14:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - WIB (UTC +7): 10:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - IST (UTC +5:30): 08:30, Feb, 29th, 2024
    - IDT (UTC +2): 05:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - CET (UTC +1): 04:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - GMT (UTC +0): 03:00, Feb. 29th, 2024
    - EDT (UTC -4): 22:00, Feb. 28th, 2024


If any changes were made in schedule, we will notify via notice again.

Thank you.

Random Tower Defense Team

a. You can ban(ignore) other player by using command in chat.

c. You can find the player banned by you in the Blacklist, and you can unban(unignore) the player.

2. Team Chat for Duo Game
a. You can chat with your team member as ‘Team Chat’ in duo game.
b. You can send your message to all players by entering command ‘/all’ or Shift+Enter Key.

Any swearing and violent language is strictly prohibited and subject to restriction. 
If you are reported many times by using swearing and violent language, you will be banned to chat.

notes.title: A Sneak peek at Upcoming Changes, Updates and Roadmap!
notes.content:
[h1]A Sneak peek at Upcoming Changes, Updates and Roadmap![/h1]

We've been working hard past few weeks to finalize the details and are excited to share changes and update details for Project RTD.

[h2]New Modes Coming Soon[/h2]
We will be adding a new 6-player mode along with several other modes.

[b][h3]Single Player Challenge Mode - Coming 3/12(PDT) [/h3][/b]
This is a 40-round single player mode. The goal is to defeat the final boss. There are 5 levels of difficulties and rewards for clearing each difficulty level.

[b][h3]Duo Game Mode - Coming Late March ~ Early April(PDT)[/h3][/b]
Duo Mode is a new mode for 2 players to party up in a PvP and fight with other teams. We will first release the Duo Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/f7463660ed65791080d47c57bc50b7874efa142d.png[/img]

[h2]Making Project RTD More Accessible[/h2]
[h3]Free Demo – Coming 3/26(PDT)[/h3]
A free demo will offer initial tutorial , a Normal Mode, Friendly PvP Mode(other modes are available in the full game).

The demo will be supported for the foreseeable future. Exact time frame will be announced at a later date after the demo launches.

A free demo anyone can try and easily experience what Project RTD is like with a tutorial and a normal & friendly match.

[h3]Changes to Game Purchase – Coming 3/26 18:00(PDT) [/h3]
To welcome the new players coming over from the demo, we will be separating the season pass from the base game. The base game will feature a lower price and the season pass will become an optional purchase.

As a big thank-you to our original player base, the Early Access season pass that was included with the initial purchase will be converted to the new season pass where seasonal content will continue to be updated. If you bought the game initially before this change, nothing changes. You already have the game and the new season pass.

And moreover, we’ve also prepared more gifts to our original player base. If you’ve purchased the game before we separated the game and the season pass, you will be receiving special in-game gifts.

[list][*]Before:[/list]
Project RTD w/Premium Season Pass: $19.99
ㄴ Season pass was only valid during the Early Access period.

[list][*]After:[/list]
Project RTD(base game, All game modes available):$8.99

Premium Season Pass(Upgraded, a new separate DLC): $11.99
ㄴNew season pass will offer seasonal contents going forward.

Premium Edition Bundle = Project RTD + Premium Season Pass

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/63ef6b60aeccf439db1e15ab984c8104c3dad7f9.png[/img]


[Special Note]
1. The old Premium Season Pass which was automatically included will be converted to the new separate season pass.

2. Players who have purchased the game before the base game + season pass separation will automatically receive all the new seasonal content offered in the upgraded season pass DLC.

3. The newly upgraded season pass will offer a variety of content which can be unlocked by completing seasonal missions.

4. Premium Season Pass will be renewed on a regular cycle.

5. Exact dates may change depending on Steam's update interval.

[h3]Special Gift[/h3]
Due to the new change, we plan on offering special in-game gifts to those who have purchased the game before the separation and log in the game before 2020 March 26 17:59  PDT.

[h2]Project RTD Roadmap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/12e04284016ec8201f7a5bde569e5b2f002aa7d6.png[/img]

Our goal is to leave the Early Access this year and release the game and host on & offline tournaments.

We are humbled by the positive feedback and support. We hope you are excited about our roadmap and we’ll continue to work hard on the development.

Thank you for welcoming us in the Early Access and we hope more players will join us with the new changes and update!

notes.content:

[h3]TEAM UP IN DUO MODE[/h3]

Duo Mode is a new mode for 2 players to party up in a PvP and fight with other teams. 
PVP mode for 3 teams of players. (2 VS 2 VS 2)
     - You can start Duo Game alone or with a friend.

      - Duo Game is only available from 18:00 to 23:59 every day during the free season.  The open time can be changed with a notice. 


[h3]Making Project RTD More Accessible[/h3]
Free Demo -A free demo anyone can try and easily experience what Project RTD is like with  normal, friendly match and first level of Challenge Game are playable.

The demo will be supported for the foreseeable future. 
Exact time frame will be announced at a later date after the demo launches.

[h3]Changes to Game Purchase[/h3]

To welcome the new players coming over from the demo, we will be separating the season pass from the base game. The base game will feature a lower price and the season pass will become an optional purchase.

As a big thank-you to our original player base, the Early Access season pass that was included with the initial purchase will be converted to the new season pass where seasonal content will continue to be updated. If you bought the game initially before this change, nothing changes. You already have the game and the new season pass.

And moreover, we’ve also prepared more gifts to our original player base. If you’ve purchased the game before we separated the game and the season pass, you will be receiving special in-game gifts. Special in-game gifts including a special name card(tentative name) and tower’s voice will be given on April 03.

[Special Note]
1. The old Premium Season Pass which was automatically included will be converted to the new separate season pass.

2. Players who have purchased the game before the base game + season pass separation will automatically receive all the new seasonal content offered in the upgraded season pass DLC.

3. The newly upgraded season pass will offer a variety of content which can be unlocked by completing seasonal missions.

4. Premium Season Pass will be renewed on a regular cycle.


[ Other improvement and bugs fixed] 
1. Server Optimization
     - Fixed 0.2 seconds of delay under normal internet connection.
     - Optimized the server to minimize the delay under slow internet connection.

  2. Added ‘Reduce sparkling effect’ option in Settings. 

  3.Updated the Hidden Missions to be applied to Normal Game and Duo Game. 

  4. Acquirable daily reward can be seen while loading in rank game.

  5.If tier could be dropped by next game’s result, you get warning in waiting room and result scene in advance. 

6. Fixed a bug that Epic Tower Lockdown’s skill motion of ‘Barrage of Doom’ wasn’t displayed. 

  7. You can find where your mouse cursor is by left click during the game.

  8. Changed the placed Towers to show their front during the preparation time. 

* We focused on system update and balance patch for 7th and 8th week of early access to improve fun of game play, so there is no additional balance patch for this week. Related changes will be notified in other update note.

Await you in the battlefield!

notes.title: A Sneak peek at Upcoming Changes, Updates and Roadmap!
notes.content:
[h1]A Sneak peek at Upcoming Changes, Updates and Roadmap![/h1]

We've been working hard past few weeks to finalize the details and are excited to share changes and update details for Project RTD.

[h2]New Modes Coming Soon[/h2]
We will be adding a new 6-player mode along with several other modes.

[b][h3]Single Player Challenge Mode - Coming 3/12(PDT) [/h3][/b]
This is a 40-round single player mode. The goal is to defeat the final boss. There are 5 levels of difficulties and rewards for clearing each difficulty level.

[b][h3]Duo Game Mode - Coming Late March ~ Early April(PDT)[/h3][/b]
Duo Mode is a new mode for 2 players to party up in a PvP and fight with other teams. We will first release the Duo Mode. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/f7463660ed65791080d47c57bc50b7874efa142d.png[/img]

[h2]Making Project RTD More Accessible[/h2]
[h3]Free Demo – Coming 3/26(PDT)[/h3]
A free demo will offer initial tutorial , a Normal Mode, Friendly PvP Mode(other modes are available in the full game).

The demo will be supported for the foreseeable future. Exact time frame will be announced at a later date after the demo launches.

A free demo anyone can try and easily experience what Project RTD is like with a tutorial and a normal & friendly match.

[h3]Changes to Game Purchase – Coming 3/26 18:00(PDT) [/h3]
To welcome the new players coming over from the demo, we will be separating the season pass from the base game. The base game will feature a lower price and the season pass will become an optional purchase.

As a big thank-you to our original player base, the Early Access season pass that was included with the initial purchase will be converted to the new season pass where seasonal content will continue to be updated. If you bought the game initially before this change, nothing changes. You already have the game and the new season pass.

And moreover, we’ve also prepared more gifts to our original player base. If you’ve purchased the game before we separated the game and the season pass, you will be receiving special in-game gifts.

[list][*]Before:[/list]
Project RTD w/Premium Season Pass: $19.99
ㄴ Season pass was only valid during the Early Access period.

[list][*]After:[/list]
Project RTD(base game, All game modes available):$8.99

Premium Season Pass(Upgraded, a new separate DLC): $11.99
ㄴNew season pass will offer seasonal contents going forward.

Premium Edition Bundle = Project RTD + Premium Season Pass

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/63ef6b60aeccf439db1e15ab984c8104c3dad7f9.png[/img]


[Special Note]
1. The old Premium Season Pass which was automatically included will be converted to the new separate season pass.

2. Players who have purchased the game before the base game + season pass separation will automatically receive all the new seasonal content offered in the upgraded season pass DLC.

3. The newly upgraded season pass will offer a variety of content which can be unlocked by completing seasonal missions.

4. Premium Season Pass will be renewed on a regular cycle.

5. Exact dates may change depending on Steam's update interval.

[h3]Special Gift[/h3]
Due to the new change, we plan on offering special in-game gifts to those who have purchased the game before the separation and log in the game before 2020 March 26 17:59  PDT.

[h2]Project RTD Roadmap[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36457217/12e04284016ec8201f7a5bde569e5b2f002aa7d6.png[/img]

Our goal is to leave the Early Access this year and release the game and host on & offline tournaments.

We are humbled by the positive feedback and support. We hope you are excited about our roadmap and we’ll continue to work hard on the development.

Thank you for welcoming us in the Early Access and we hope more players will join us with the new changes and update!
